rawContent: @GavinNewsom has an important choice to make for CA Attorney General. @RobBontaCA has been a strong ally for #BlackLivesMatter. He’s taken on powerful interests in Sacramento to end cash bail, outlaw private prisons and invest in our communities. He’d make a great AG.
